_doc: Copy and facts used to build the transfer landing pages at /taxi/<route>. Prices are NOT here - they stay in taxi-rates.json, the single source of truth. Edit this file to change wording; the pages read it at build time.
_ownerCheck: Journey times and distances below are approximate driving estimates and have NOT been confirmed by the owner. They are shown on the page as 'about X'. Correct any that are wrong - each appears in exactly one place.

pafos-airport.intro: The short hop between Pafos Airport (PFO) and town or the resorts. We watch your flight, so a delay costs you nothing, and we meet you in arrivals with a name board.
highlights: We track your flight and wait if it lands late
Meet and greet in the arrivals hall
Door to door - hotel, villa or apartment

pegeia.intro: Pegeia and the Coral Bay strip, just north of Pafos. A common run for guests staying in the villas above the bay.
highlights: Covers Coral Bay, Pegeia village and the surrounding villas
Door to door, including the steep villa roads
Same fixed fare in both directions

pafos-zoo.intro: A day out at Pafos Zoo without the parking. We can drop you off and collect you at a time you choose.
highlights: Drop off at the gate
Tell us your pick-up time and we come back for you
Room for pushchairs in the minibuses

limassol.intro: Pafos to Limassol along the coast road - the marina, the old town, the port and the hotel strip.
highlights: Motorway the whole way
Fixed price whatever the traffic
Cruise port and marina drop-offs

larnaca-airport.intro: The long airport run across the island to Larnaca (LCA). Worth booking ahead - it is the transfer most often needed at an awkward hour.
highlights: Early morning and late night departures covered
Flight tracked on arrivals, so delays are not your problem
One fixed fare for the vehicle, not per person

nicosia.intro: Pafos to the capital, for business, the hospitals or a day in the old walled city.
highlights: Door to door anywhere in Nicosia
Waiting time can be arranged - just ask
Fixed fare agreed before you travel

ayia-napa.intro: Right across the island to Ayia Napa and the eastern beaches. A long run, so the fixed price and a comfortable vehicle matter.
highlights: Air-conditioned vehicle for the full journey
Comfort stop on request
Luggage space for a full group's cases

protaras.intro: Pafos to Protaras, Paralimni and Fig Tree Bay - the far end of the island, done in one comfortable run.
highlights: Covers Protaras, Paralimni and Fig Tree Bay
Air-conditioned vehicle for the full journey
Fixed fare per vehicle, agreed up front

sharedFaqs.q: Is the price per person or per vehicle?
sharedFaqs.a: Per vehicle, one way. The fare covers the whole group up to the vehicle's size, so four people pay the same as one.
No. Send the request, we confirm the fare and the pick-up time by phone or WhatsApp, and you pay the driver.

sharedFaqs.q: Is the fare the same in both directions?
sharedFaqs.a: Yes - the same fixed price whether we are taking you there or bringing you back.
